CREATE TABLE cj_enum_values(id integer,v cj_enums); INSERT INTO cj_enum_values VALUES(1,ROW('a'::cj_enum)),(2,ROW('a'::cj_enum)),(3,ROW('b'::cj_enum)); PREPARE cj_enum_join(cj_enums) AS SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM cj_enum_values a JOIN (SELECT 1 AS id,$1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2,ROW('a'::cj_enum)::cj_enums) b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r
EXECUTE cj_enum_join(ROW('a'::cj_enum)::cj_enums)
ALTER TYPE cj_enum RENAME VALUE 'a' TO 'renamed'
EXECUTE cj_enum_join(ROW('renamed'::cj_enum)::cj_enums)

CREATE TYPE cj_old_enum AS ENUM ('first','last'); CREATE TYPE cj_new_enum AS ENUM ('new'); CREATE TYPE cj_enum_carrier AS(e cj_old_enum); CREATE VIEW cj_enum_first AS SELECT '(first)'::cj_enum_carrier AS v; CREATE VIEW cj_enum_last AS SELECT '(last)'::cj_enum_carrier AS v; ALTER TYPE cj_enum_carrier ALTER ATTRIBUTE e TYPE cj_new_enum
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_enum_first a JOIN cj_enum_first b ON a.v=b.v
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_enum_first a JOIN cj_enum_last b ON a.v=b.v
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT v FROM cj_enum_first UNION ALL SELECT v FROM cj_enum_first) a JOIN (SELECT v FROM cj_enum_first UNION ALL SELECT v FROM cj_enum_first) b ON a.v=b.v
SELECT count(*) FROM cj_enum_first a JOIN cj_enum_first b ON ARRAY[a.v]=ARRAY[b.v]

PREPARE cj_physical_join(cj_physical) AS SELECT a.id AS l,b.id AS r FROM (VALUES(1,'(hello,8)'::cj_physical),(2,'(other,9)'::cj_physical)) a(id,v) JOIN (SELECT 1 AS id,$1 AS v) b ON a.v=b.v ORDER BY l,r; ALTER TYPE cj_physical ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bytea
EXECUTE cj_physical_join(ROW(decode('68656c6c6f','hex'),8)::cj_physical)
CREATE SEQUENCE cj_sequence
